# exemplifies

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:exemplifies`](gmeow-exemplifies.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/exemplifies>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/creative-works`](../../slices/creative-works.md)

Relates an [`Item`](../classes/gmeow-Item.md) to the [`Manifestation`](../classes/gmeow-Manifestation.md) it exemplifies. Non-functional: a single [`Item`](../classes/gmeow-Item.md) may exemplify multiple Manifestations when catalogued as a bound volume. Inverse of [`gmeow:exemplifiedBy`](gmeow-exemplifiedBy.md).

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:Item`](../classes/gmeow-Item.md) -> [`gmeow:Manifestation`](../classes/gmeow-Manifestation.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:exemplifies`](gmeow-exemplifies.md) from [`gmeow:Item`](../classes/gmeow-Item.md) to [`gmeow:Manifestation`](../classes/gmeow-Manifestation.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.
